description: This PHP source file defines the class `FormatWithMembershipId`, which implements the `ValueFormatter` interface. Its purpose is to fetch and format a membership name based on a given membership ID by utilizing the `MembershipService`.

classes.name: FormatWithMembershipId
classes.description: A class that formats membership IDs into membership names using a service to retrieve membership details.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the membership name corresponding to a given membership ID, or null if not found.

methods.name: getMembershipService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the instance of MembershipService used by this class.
